purpose: Register of conflicts, ambiguities, representation differences, gaps and assumptions found in the supplied evidence.
rules: No source precedence: no entry is decided by "JSON wins", "RTF wins" or "newest wins".
Every decision is a non-destructive handling: both/all raw claims are kept and marked unresolved unless the entry is a pure representation rule.
Quotes are verbatim substrings located in the originals at build time; counts are measured.

entries.title: Layout grain: DOCX layout categories vs registry model/interior IDs; upgraded 138-seat 737-700 has no registry record

claims.quote: Single cabin, 3-3 seating; exit row changed from two seats to three on the affected side
The 137-seat and 138-seat 737-700 layouts are both in circulation while 170 selected -700s are upgraded.

claims.subject: occurrences of the token "138" as a whole number in registry JSON text / RTF text

entries.claim_scope: Layout / LayoutRevision identity for all aircraft; specifically the 737-700.
entries.why_conflict_or_ambiguity: The DOCX layout table has 4 category rows (two 737-700 categories by capacity, two shared 737-800/MAX 8 categories by programme stage); the registry has 5 records keyed by model + interior (73G, 738, 7M8-1, 738-2, 7M8-2). This is partly a grain difference (representation of the same fleet at different granularity) and partly substantive: the DOCX category with capacity 138 has no registry record (registry totals: 137, 175), and the DOCX gives no seat-by-seat list for it — only an arrangement sentence and the seats named in C02.
entries.impact_on_application: No candidate seat set exists for a 138-seat 737-700. A visit on such an aircraft cannot be served by any supplied seat map; silently using 73G would show a wrong seat count.
entries.decision_for_software: Keep every registry lopa_id as its own candidate LayoutRevision. Record the DOCX categories as separate layout-category claims. Link the two through an explicit crosswalk table whose rows are marked "assumed, unverified" (see C22). Create the 138-seat category as a placeholder Layout with status "no seat set supplied" that cannot be selected for seat-level work. Never synthesise a 138-seat set by adding a seat to 73G. Unresolved.
entries.evidence_still_needed: An approved LOPA / seat list for the 138-seat 737-700, and an authoritative mapping between layout categories and model/interior identifiers.
